notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the token Priest of Urabrasks enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding fifteen {R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
